status: integrated Go codec implementation; whole-plugin acceptance tracked only by migration/ledger.json

pure_go_dependencies.source_need: Actual installed Pillow accepts BMP/TIFF/WebP; prior reused Go helper rejects all. Native codec hashes are differential-tested against actual333 original Tjupt AST.

adaptations: Pillow decompression warning category/message goes to worker stderr once per message. Python filename/line and process-global warnings registry are not retained.
No encoded input, 8192 dimension, 16Mpixel, or 64MiB working-buffer policy is added by this helper. Actual SDK transport/body limits remain host-owned.
Pure Go BMP/WebP/JP2/J2K/TIFF codecs with Pillow-mode/resize mapping; no CGo or Python product runtime.
Explicit double-rounding boundaries keep resampler behavior consistent on ARM64 without fused multiply-add.
Unrecognized/malformed image errors retain Go decoder diagnostics; Python exception class/traceback text is not reproduced.
JP2 ICC profile remains metadata as in fixed Pillow; bypass the Go decoder automatic matrix/TRC conversion without changing codestream/palette/channel data.
BigTIFF first IFD is normalized to the same decoder while original strips/tiles remain unchanged. The host body transport is below the classic4GiB address space.
Root Go minimum rises1.26.0→1.26.4 only because the pure Go AV1 decoder requires that patch. Host SDK105 source and deployed/previous prebuilt workers are unchanged.
remaining_unimplemented_or_unverified: Registered-only Pillow readers for which no positive default Image.open/load/hash source fixture was obtained remain explicitly outside the finite codec evidence. Do not infer successful decode or approved exclusion from registration or failed writer controls.
Other compression/depth/CICP variants and malformed diagnostics beyond finite source-positive cases are not exhaustively certified.
Other native Pillow codec variants/registered-only formats remain finite-scope unverified; do not promote wholeASI from this increment.

jpeg2000.scope: pure Go Part1 JP2/J2K decode; source lossless/lossy/alpha/grayscale/16bit/tiled fixtures
jpeg2000.delivery: private decoder-only relocation with source arithmetic corrections, not a shared external module

adaptations: Preserve signed I/float F samples until Pillow resize and final L conversion.
CCITT mode1 polarity matches original libtiff for PhotometricInterpretation0/1.
JPEG strips use the same private libjpeg-compatible JPEG reconstruction.
Scalar horizontal and floating byte-plane predictors match actual compressed source samples.
ImageOps.exif_transpose at source load_end is applied to native Raster samples before resize; all8 source orientations checked.

source_extra_expected.classification: Actual immutable333/Pillow 12.2 default-image source controls, including the TIFF layout increment. BLP1 and legacy fixtures are stored separately.

avif.scope: pure Go AV1 bitstream/container; no CGo, native library, WASM or subprocess. Existing host prebuilt stays unchanged.
avif.pillow_pixel_adaptation: Source 8bit YUV conversion uses rounded libyuv constants and byte-plane bilinear upsampling; default gav1d float conversion caused actual source pixel/hash mismatch.

libyuv_origin.scope: YuvPixel constants, chroma interpolation, and coded AVIF plane scaling. Ratio filters preserve the installed AVX2 rounding and scalar tails. No native runtime.

avif.orientation: Pillow exposes irot/imir as EXIF metadata, without applying them in Image.open/load. AutoRotate false, checked against8 actual source orientation controls.
